newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Council sets up employment committee.
newsitem.headline: Council sets up employment committee.

text.p: The Social Affairs Council adopted legislation on Monday to set up an Employment and Labour Market Policy Committee to advise it on employment issues.
The committee, proposed in draft decision COM(96)134, will have a status similar to that of the Economic Policy Committee, which advises the ECOFIN Council.
It will be composed of two representatives from each member state and two from the Commission.
The committee will study national employment and labour market policies and promote information exchanges between member states and with the Commission.
It will prepare reports and proposals for the Council on those questions.
